messages:
alex_chang: Heads-up 0: partner asks for a single repo that contains AWS + GCP marketplace packaging, plus build matrix for arm/x86 images and a minimal CI that validates listing artifacts. We should scope what "packaging" means here.

maya_ng: For marketplace listing artifacts we need: short/long descriptions, 2-3 screenshots, machine types/regions, pricing metadata, support contact, and a license file. Legal sign-off required on public text.

carla_lee: GCP marketplace has slightly different packaging (Cloud Marketplace Images vs. VM Marketplace) and needs a marketplace config.yaml (see docs). We'll include a docs/marketplace/gcp.md with the exact required fields.

sam_keller: On the build side: plan to produce 1) AMI for each arch + imaging runbook, 2) container images (multi-arch manifest), and 3) an optional helm chart for k8s installs. I'll sketch a build matrix: linux/ubuntu-22.04 x86_64, linux/ubuntu-22.04 arm64, container: amd64/arm64 multi-arch, and provide recommended instance types per workload (e.g., a2/highmem for small models, c6i for inferencing).

linh_tran: I'll write GH Actions workflows: build/publish AMI via Packer + release pipeline for containers (buildx push), then a smoke workflow that launches minimal infra in partner account (assume role) and runs /health + single inference. Keep smoke <8m.

alex_chang: Example README snippet for module usage? we should include both terraform and cloudbuild examples. Something tiny partners can copy: 

```terraform
module "redwood_marketplace" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/terraform-partner-accelerator//aws"
  name   = "partner-quickstart"
  arch   = "arm64" # or x86_64
  model  = "redwood/llama-3-70b"
}
```

and a build example: 

```bash
# build multi-arch container and push
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/partner/llm-quick:1.0 --push .
```

sam_keller: I'll add a variables.tf with recommended defaults + example values for arm/x86. Also adding quantization note: if you use int8 quantized weights, CPU inference profiles change.

maya_ng: Timeline suggestion: initial repo + README + basic GH actions by next Tue, marketplace docs + legal copy by Thu, partner handoff doc + sample listing artifacts by next Friday. Who can own the partner walkthrough?

carla_lee: I can do the walkthrough doc and record a 10-12 minute screen share showing how to fork, fill in listing fields, and run the smoke test.

alex_chang: Perfect. Also add a short section in the README about Dedicated vs Hosted: how to configure routing (pin model_version, fallback) and KMS notes for private images. Juan from infra recommended a VPC example and KMS snippet; probably add that under security.md.

devops_bot: pipeline scaffold created: partner-build-matrix (GH Actions) and smoke-infra-workflow added to repo terraform-partner-accelerator. CODEOWNERS updated.

linh_tran: Quick question: do we want to publish example AMI IDs (per region) or leave instructions to run the Packer job? I prefer instructions + a small manifest generator so partners publish their own AMIs.

sam_keller: Agree with instructions only. Publishing AMI IDs is messy across accounts/regions. We'll include a small manifest template: manifests/amis.example.json and a script to convert to marketplace-required metadata.

maya_ng: Legal check: I'll submit the listing copy to legal once we have the long description and support email. Also add an export control blurb to the README.

alex_chang: OK owners: sam -> infra modules & AMI guide; linh -> GH Actions + smoke; carla -> walkthrough + marketplace gcp nuances; maya -> marketplace checklist + legal; I'll coordinate partner handoff and the sample listing bundle.

devops_bot: task created: PART-481 - marketplace-packaging-matrix. Due 2026-04-07. Assignees: sam_keller, linh_tran, carla_lee, maya_ng, alex_chang.

carla_lee: I'll start a short Loom today for the partner walkthrough and drop the link in the repo.

alex_chang: Awesome. If anyone hits blockers with IAM roles for partner accounts, ping me and Ill jump on a quick call.

linh_tran: Opening PR for GH Actions (build + smoke) now. Expect draft by EOD.
